meta.name: 163-java-profiling-refactor
meta.description: Use when you need to refactor Java code based on profiling analysis findings — including reviewing docs/profiling-problem-analysis and docs/profiling-solutions, identifying specific performance bottlenecks, and implementing targeted code changes to address CPU, memory, or threading issues. This should trigger for requests such as Refactor the code with profiling; Apply profiling; Refactor the code with profiling; Optimize hot path. Part of cursor-rules-java project
